cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Silcoon

attacks.name: Cocoon Collector
attacks.effect: Put 3 random cards from among Silcoon and Cascoon from your deck onto your Bench.

cards.description: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Evoflight
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Evolution Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

cards.name: Cascoon

attacks.name: Cocoon Collector
attacks.effect: Put 3 random cards from among Silcoon and Cascoon from your deck onto your Bench.

cards.description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Dustox

abilities.name: Variety Powder
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. 1 Special Condition from among Burned, Confused, and Poisoned is chosen at random, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. Any Special Conditions already affecting that Pokémon will not be chosen.

cards.description: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Lileep

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.description: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

cards.name: Cradily

attacks.name: Stick and Absorb
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.description: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Combee

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

cards.description: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

attacks.name: Chase Order
attacks.effect: You may discard 1 of your Benched Basic [G] Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

cards.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Deck and Cover
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

cards.description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.description: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

cards.name: Pheromosa

attacks.name: Prelude
attacks.effect: If you haven't gotten any points, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.description: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

cards.name: Poltchageist

abilities.name: Hospitality
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may heal 20 damage from your Active [G] Pokémon.

cards.description: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

cards.name: Sinistcha

attacks.name: Scald
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.description: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

cards.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon

attacks.name: Ogre's Whip
attacks.effect: This attack does damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to this Pokémon's remaining HP.

cards.description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

cards.name: Ponyta

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.effect: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

cards.description: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

cards.name: Flareon

attacks.name: Burning Tail
attacks.effect: Discard a Fire Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.description: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Sky Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.description: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Heat Wave
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.description: The fur covering this Pokémon's body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

attacks.name: Destructive Inferno
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Sharp Claws
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.description: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Migraine
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.description: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: It swims grace­ fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

cards.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

attacks.name: Turbo Shark
attacks.effect: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched [W] Pokémon.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

attacks.name: Wondrous Waves
attacks.effect: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probes the sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs the Walrein in its herd.

cards.name: Sealeo

attacks.name: Frozen Splash
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a [F] Pokémon, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.description: This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round things on its nose, whether those things are Poké Balls or Spheal.

cards.name: Walrein

attacks.name: Blizzlock
attacks.effect: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.

cards.description: Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.

cards.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Tidal Blast
attacks.effect: Discard 3 [W] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: It's said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.

cards.name: Dewott

attacks.name: Razor Shell
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.description: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.

cards.name: Samurott

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Pike
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

cards.name: Alomomola

attacks.name: Mineral Pump
attacks.effect: Heal 10 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.

cards.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.description: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid's gnashing jaws.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.description: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do -20 damage.

cards.description: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Raichu

abilities.name: Evoshock
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.description: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

cards.name: Luxray

attacks.name: Revenge Blast
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 more damage for each point your opponent has gotten.

cards.description: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Crackling Snap
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is an Item, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

attacks.name: Junk Spark
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each Item card in your discard pile.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

cards.name: Eelektross

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

cards.name: Thundurus

attacks.name: Disaster Volt
attacks.effect: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

cards.name: Helioptile

attacks.name: Jumping Kick
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

cards.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Electrispark
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Mini-Metronome
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

cards.description: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

cards.name: Mime Jr.

attacks.name: Mime-y Shuffle
attacks.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand.

cards.description: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Synchro Dance
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.description: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.effect: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

cards.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.effect: Put a random Supporter card from your deck into your hand.

cards.description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and POKéMON. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.effect: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.description: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

cards.name: Wynaut

attacks.name: Stompy Jammer
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.

cards.description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

cards.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Air Cutter
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

cards.name: Hoopa

attacks.name: Mischievous Ring
attacks.effect: Before doing damage, shuffle all Pokémon Tools from each of your opponent's Pokémon into their deck.

cards.description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Oricorio

attacks.name: Supernatural Feather
attacks.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

cards.description: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

cards.name: Hariyama

attacks.name: Pivot Throw
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes +50 damage from attacks.

cards.description: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.description: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Armaldo

attacks.name: Abyssal Drop
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Choose a spot from among your opponent's Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent's next turn, Knock Out the Pokémon in the spot you chose.

cards.description: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

cards.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.effect: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

attacks.name: Resonating Blade
attacks.effect: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

cards.name: Gurdurr

attacks.name: Pummel
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

cards.name: Conkeldurr

attacks.name: Bedrock Breaker
attacks.effect: Discard a Stadium in play.

cards.description: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

cards.name: Minior

attacks.name: Cosmic Tackle
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has an Ability, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.description: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: When two of these Pokémon's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

cards.name: Muk

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.description: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

cards.name: Poochyena

attacks.name: Team Hunt
attacks.effect: Draw a card for each Poochyena you have in play.

cards.description: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

cards.name: Mightyena
cards.description: Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a sign, and its whole pack moves out.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
cards.description: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone

attacks.name: Night Slash
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon

attacks.name: Bass Control
attacks.effect: This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Gulpin
cards.description: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

cards.name: Swalot

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has less remaining HP than this Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.description: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

cards.name: Absol

attacks.name: Enhanced Blade
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.description: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

cards.name: Vullaby

attacks.name: Run Around
attacks.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.description: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

cards.name: Mandibuzz

attacks.name: Bone Rush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.description: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

attacks.name: Shadow Bullet
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamite Punch
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and sharp, people apparently once used them as swords.

cards.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Beldum

abilities.name: Conductive Body
abilities.effect: If you have another Beldum in play, this Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 2 less.

cards.description: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

cards.name: Metang

attacks.name: Bullet Punch
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.description: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

cards.name: Metagross

attacks.name: Squared Attack
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.description: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.

attacks.name: Gatling Slug
attacks.effect: This attack does 10 more damage for each [M] Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

cards.name: Genesect

attacks.name: Techno Blast
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.description: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

cards.name: Archaludon

attacks.name: Raging Blade
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

cards.name: Revavroom

abilities.name: Dual Customization
abilities.effect: This Pokémon may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Overacceleration
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overacceleration attack does +70 damage.

cards.description: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.description: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

cards.name: Dragonair

abilities.name: Dragon's Blessing
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may attach an Energy from your discard pile to your Active Dragon Pokémon.

cards.description: It is called the divine POKéMON. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

cards.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.description: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

cards.name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Dragon Impact
attacks.effect: Discard 2 random Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

attacks.name: Mega Burst
attacks.effect: Discard all [R] and [L] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage for each Energy you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: Noibat can change the frequency of its sound waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of up to 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Noivern

attacks.name: Draco Meteor
attacks.effect: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 60 damage to it.

cards.description: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

cards.name: Turtonator

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.description: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

cards.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Power Blast
attacks.effect: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Applin
cards.description: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

cards.name: Dipplin

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

cards.name: Hydrapple

attacks.name: Fickle Beam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.description: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

cards.name: Cyclizar

attacks.name: Acceleration Drive
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

cards.name: Rattata

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.description: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

cards.name: Raticate

abilities.name: Treasure Collecting
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put all Item cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
